conferences.edition: EPS Meeting, University College London, January 2027

deadlines.label: Abstract portals for talks and posters (opened 10am UK time and stayed open for 24 hours; submissions now assessed and closed)

conferences.typical_timing: EPS abstract portals for January meetings usually open in early September of the previous year. Portals for the Spring meeting open in early January, and for the Summer meeting in early April. The next portal, for the Cardiff meeting on 7-9 April 2027, opens Monday 18 January 2027.

conferences.typical_timing: Submissions opened 1 October 2026. ESCOP lists the abstract deadline as around October/November 2026, but I couldn't find an exact date. Past edition: TeaP 2019 had a 15 January deadline.

conferences.name: European Conference on Visual Perception (ECVP)
conferences.edition: ECVP 2027 (49th European Conference on Visual Perception)
conferences.typical_timing: Based on ECVP 2026: symposium proposals ran from mid-December to about 10 February, and the abstract and early-bird registration deadline was in early April (April 7, 2026). Expect something similar for 2027.

conferences.name: AMLaP (Architectures and Mechanisms for Language Processing)
conferences.typical_timing: Usually mid-April to early May, about 4 months before the early-September conference. The 2026 deadline was 1 May, extended to 8 May. The 2023 deadline was 15 April.

conferences.edition: HSP 2027 (40th Annual Conference on Human Sentence Processing)

conferences.name: MathPsych / ICCM
conferences.typical_timing: Usually the meeting is in July. Submissions open in early January and close in late February (28 Feb 2024, 28 Feb 2026). Final decisions come by about 30 April.

deadlines.label: Content submissions open (poster abstracts, symposia, courses, roundtables; reviewer applications)
Content submission and abstract review volunteer deadline

conferences.name: FENS Forum
conferences.typical_timing: Abstracts, early registration and travel grants usually close in late January or early February of the Forum year (5 Feb 2026 for FENS Forum 2026, after an extension). The call for symposia and workshops usually closes in about May of the year before (5 May 2025 for 2026).

conferences.name: SfN Neuroscience
conferences.typical_timing: Usually late spring. For Neuroscience 2026, abstract submission opened May 27 and the deadline was extended to June 11. Third-party sites estimate May 20, 2027 for 2027, but SfN has not published that date.
